user.title: Select Serial Port
user.description: Choose the USB serial adapter connected to the Autoterm heater. The FTDI FT232R entry (from the VAN PI adapter) will be pre-selected if present.

manual.title: Manual Port Entry
manual.description: Enter the full path to the serial device. Use the stable /dev/serial/by-id/... form, not /dev/ttyUSBx.

error.port_not_found: Device path does not exist. Ensure the adapter is connected.
